name: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk
summary: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes breads in Indonesia. The company offers white and sweet breads, cakes, and chocolates, as well as milk and jam under the Sari Roti, Sari Kue, and Sari Choco brand names. It also engages in the processing of dairy products, fruits, vegetables, juices, and soft drinks; and wholesale of bakery products, non-alcohol beverages, non-dairy, milk and dairy products, food from chocolate, and confectionary of chocolate.
